name: NYC Planimetric Database: Open Space (Other)
description: This dataset contains polygon features representing open spaces in New York City that fall outside the main categories of parks and recreational facilities, drawn from the city's Planimetric Database. Each record describes one open-space area with a source identifier, feature and sub-feature classification codes, a name where available, a status field, and geometric attributes including area and perimeter length. The sample of 5,000 rows covers a range of miscellaneous open spaces such as plazas, greenways, and other undeveloped or publicly accessible land. The data can support mapping and spatial analysis of open space, land-use and urban planning studies, comparisons of open-space distribution across neighborhoods, and GIS work that requires area and boundary information for non-park open areas.
